desc:
Welcome to +1 Jump Pogo Keyboard Escape!

⚡ Every jump = +1 Jump
🦘 Bounce your way across a giant world made entirely of keyboards and keycaps
🚀 Upgrade your pogo stick and jump higher than ever
💪 Train your jump power and unlock powerful multipliers
👥 Bounce alongside friends and other players
🌍 Become the JUMPIEST player on the server

🎧 Satisfying keyboard vibes included
Enjoy smooth bouncing, satisfying keycap clicks, colorful keyboards, and relaxing sounds for the perfect mix of jumping, upgrading, and chilling ✨
